summary: Avnet, Inc. filed a Form 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 3 to its Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated January 17, 2025. On October 13, 2026, Avnet and Avnet Holding Europe BV, with Bank of America as administrative agent, increased aggregate revolving commitments by $1.0 billion to $2.75 billion, raised the accordion capacity to $1.0 billion, and eliminated the SOFR credit spread adjustment. No price, stake, premium, or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch for drawdowns or M&A funding implications.
